title: Base change commutes with a fibre product
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and let $k'/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. There is a canonical isomorphism of $k'$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base] $(X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}Y)\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k' \cong (X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k')\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k'}(Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k')$, where each fibre product and base change is as in [def-pc-fibre-product] and [def-pc-base-change], compatible with the projections to the two base-changed factors.
